debug_mode.description: Enable verbose debug logging (not recommended for production).

log_path.description: Path to the log file (empty string to log to syslog).

max_conn_per_ip.description: Maximum number of concurrent SSH connections allowed per IP address.

max_conn_per_user.description: Maximum number of concurrent SSH connections allowed per user.

ssh_port.description: TCP port on which the SSH/SFTP service will listen.

listen_addr.description: IP address to bind the SSH/SFTP service (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '::').

chroot_path.description: Path to the root directory for chrooted users (must be owned by root).

scp_enabled.description: Enable SCP protocol support for file transfers.

password_auth.description: Allow authentication via username and password.

pub_key_auth.description: Allow authentication via SSH public keys.

login_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds allowed for client authentication before disconnect.

max_auth_tries.description: Maximum number of authentication attempts before disconnecting the client.

banner_enabled.description: Display a legal banner to users upon connection.

banner_path.description: Path to the file containing the login banner.

users.description: List of SSH users with their configurations.

home.description: User's home directory inside the chroot.

shell.description: User's login shell (often '/bin/false' for SFTP-only accounts).

groups.description: List of groups the user belongs to.

password.description: Password hash (e.g., {crypt}sha512$...). Required if password_auth is true.

groups.description: List of user groups with shared configurations.

upload_quota_mb.description: Default upload quota (MB) for group members.

allowed_ips.description: List of allowed IP ranges (CIDR notation or single IPs) to connect to the SSH service.

denied_ips.description: List of denied IP ranges to block from connecting.

path.description: Path relative to the chroot root.

read_only.description: If true, users may only read from this directory.

max_files.description: Maximum number of files allowed in this directory.

max_size.description: Maximum total size (in MB) of files in this directory.

command.description: Path or built-in command to invoke (e.g., '/usr/lib/openssh/sftp-server' or 'internal-sftp').

args.description: Arguments passed to the SFTP server command.
